positions.title: Data Scientist – AI
positions.description:
Built production multi-agent systems using LangGraph and Google ADK, delivering 5+ agentic AI solutions across enterprise customer engagements.
Designed an ADK-powered rules agent that extracts requirements from uploaded documents and auto-generates portal forms, reducing manual form creation time by 85%.
Implemented the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol enabling orchestrated multi-agent collaboration, coordinating 3+ specialized agents per workflow.
Engineered an agentic data analysis system integrating BigQuery and enterprise data sources, reducing manual reporting effort by 70% through automated insight generation.
Integrated MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect AI agents with external tools and data sources, enabling seamless access to 10+ enterprise systems and APIs.

positions.title: AI Data Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built RAG-powered chatbots using AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI with LangChain, serving 3+ enterprise clients with agentic retrieval and tool-calling workflows.
Engineered a custom vector storage solution on S3 replacing AWS OpenSearch Serverless, reducing vector database costs by 90%.
Developed a database RAG system enabling LLMs to agentically query SQL databases, improving response accuracy by 30% over traditional vector-only retrieval on structured data.
Architected a RAG SaaS platform enabling customers to upload documents and deploy AI chat widgets on their websites, onboarding 5+ early adopters.
